Name: Blood Dragon, Greatwyrm
Information:
**Blood Dragon**

Blood Dragons, known otherwise as Bloodfire Dragons, are an evolutionary off-shoot of other dragons that most likely are related to red dragons, but many believe they exist due to arcane tinkering with the eggs of red dragons. These bloody creatures have blood that is constantly burning hot, causing the dragon a constant amount of pain that numbs its mind. Thanks to this, their body is in a perpetual state of venting by sweating out extra blood, causing heat and steam around it, and it has also caused these dragons to become bestial predators that use critical thinking skills far less than other dragons. They can often be found underwater, having evolved the means to live submerged to use the water as a means of temperature regulation. If such a dragon makes a lair in a lake or bay, it will often slowly tinge the water red with its blood.

traits.name: Bloodfire Backlash
traits.description: Each time a creature deals slashing or piercing damage to the dragon from within 10 feet of it, burning blood erupts from its body and splashes onto them, forcing them to take a d12 of fire damage.

traits.name: Burning Furiosity (Recharge 4-6)
traits.description: When the dragon makes a weapon attack, it may choose to roll a new d20 and use it in place of the d20 result of that attack, possibly changing the outcome. Then, all of its attacks until the next time it ends its turn have advantage.

traits.name: Draining Blood Coat
traits.description: If the dragon has fewer than half its maximum hit points remaining, its weapon attacks deal an additional d12 of acid damage.

traits.name: Gravewyrm’s Awakening (Mythic Awakening)
traits.description: When the greatwyrm is reduced to 0 hit points or killed outright, its hit points instead reset to 400, it recharges its breath weapon, regains spent uses of its Legendary Reaction, and can use its Mythic Actions for 1 hour. A party who defeats the greatwyrm after using its Mythic Awakening are awarded an additional 120,000 XP (for a total of 240,000 XP).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The dragon makes three attacks: one with its Bite and two with its Claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +18 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (2d10 + 10) piercing damage plus 22 (4d10) fire damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +18 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d8 + 10) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +18 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 32 (4d10 + 10) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Bloodfire Breath Wave (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The dragon either spits a burst of burning, acidic blood at a point it can see within 120 feet where it explodes in a 90-foot radius sphere, or breathes the same blood in a 300-foot cone originating from itself. Each creature in range must make a DC 26 Dexterity saving throw, taking 52 (8d12) fire damage and 52 (8d12) acid damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. If used underwater, it deals 91 (14d12) acid damage instead, and no fire damage.

options.name: Attack
options.description: The dragon makes a Claw or Tail attack.

options.name: Cause Terror (Costs X Actions)
options.description: The dragon uses Legendary Actions equal to X, and targets that many creatures who can see or hear it. Each of them must make a DC 24 Wisdom saving throw. Each creature that fails is frightened of the dragon for 1 minute. While frightened, they can repeat the save at the end of each of their turns, ending the effect on a success. A creature who succeeds either save becomes immune to this action for 24 hours.

options.name: Corrosive Flame Net (Costs 2 Actions)
options.description: The dragon shakes its body, spewing acidic, burning blood around it. Each other creature within 30 feet of it must make a DC 26 Dexterity saving throw, taking 19 (2d8 + 10) acid damage and 11 (2d10) fire damage on a failed save.

mythic_actions.intro: The creature may use the following actions as Legendary Actions for 1 hour after using their Mythic Awakening.

options.name: Bite
options.description: The dragon makes a single Bite attack.

options.name: Acid Cloud (Costs 2 Actions)
options.description: The dragon unleashes a cloud of burning mist from its body that covers everything in a 120-foot radius sphere centered on it. Everything within this cloud is heavily obscured, and each time a creature starts their turn in a space within the cloud or enters into one, they take a d4 of acid damage. This cloud disappears at the end of the dragon’s next turn.
